messages:
jamal: Heads up — release v1.8.2 is tagged but release notes are under embargo until legal finishes review. Can the deployer promote the tag to prod before notes are public?

sara: Our standing rule was: no prod-promote unless release_notes_published == true and a release-manager ack exists.

alex: FWIW deploy-bot only checks the 'roles/deployer' binding right now, not the release_notes flag. That gap causes this exact confusion.

jamal: Who currently holds the release-manager role today?

marie: I hold it until 13:00 PT, then I'm OOO. If legal signs off before then I can ack.

ops-bot: AUTO: release-metadata: {release: v1.8.2, notes_state: embargoed, tagged_by: jamal, sha: abc1234} (for audit)

alex: quick check:
```
rbacctl who-can deploy --principal jamal
# roles: roles/deployer
```

alex: So jamal can press the deploy but there's no metadata gating. We should not rely on human memory here.

jamal: Proposed options: 1) Hold until legal clears and @marie ack, 2) Temporary elevate deployer->release-manager for a scoped window, 3) Manual signoff override recorded in audit. Thoughts?

sara: Option 2 is risky. If we do it, require JIT MFA + explicit audit note referencing legal approval link.

marie: If legal is quick I prefer option 1. If they need more time and it's high priority, option 3 with a clear triple-ack (marie + legal + oncall) and an ops-bot ticket is acceptable.

jamal: Legal just pinged: minor redline, likely cleared in ~45m. I'll hold the tag then.

alex: Can we patch deploy-bot to check release-metadata? Minimal change: require release_notes_published boolean or release-manager present. PR is small but not ready now.

deploy-bot: NOTE: current behavior = allow promote if principal has roles/deployer. No release_notes gating enforced. Filing issue: https://git.company/repo/issues/1123

ops-bot: Action created: OPS-4872 — temp-release-exception (linked to jamal). Added audit log entry and will require manual comment if exception used.

jamal: Okay holding. If legal clears I'll @marie and we can proceed. If not, we'll schedule a 1h emergency window tomorrow morning with proper approvals.

sara: Thanks — small followups: 1) @eng-platform to add a deploy-bot policy check for release_metadata, 2) add a one-click signoff button in console for release-manager, 3) update runbook to require JIT MFA for temporary elevations.

marie: +1 on those. I'll create a short runbook note before I sign off.

jamal: :thumbsup: will update once legal OKs.

deploy-bot: REMINDER: Any temporary role bindings must include an expiry TTL and include the approver comment.

sara: Closing note — no one should press prod until @marie posts here or we use the documented emergency window.

jamal: Understood, holding.
